identityEvaluation.truthUniverse: Initial hostile ASM only; friendly weapons/decoys/wreckage not mapped. No truth is supplied to live consumers.
identityEvaluation.lineageScope: 0-5s actual AIR UPDATE measurementId/local-file records, plus all B selected/held native returns. Outside captured lineage window remains UNKNOWN.

holdScope: Actual held plot/track sets and selected pairs come from the same native return. Module proposal HOLD counters are separate. Main AUTO cases with actual HOLD=0 do not validate every HOLD effect. Existing D1 seed419012 MANUAL/C55 autonomous RAM native terminal30.63s is a separate inherited reference, not one of these full-AUTO pages.
nativeProofScope: Runtime receipt is the actually installed outer fixed-tick entrypoint (MAP-D wrapper), plus SAM/ASM flight, Pk/applyPk and normal spawn/reset symbols. It does not serialize the underlying tick body; pinned product and root static protected-source audit establish that preservation. Extra logger select/apply sources include prior sampler wrappers. No RF/NIS/filter/solver rerun by the sampler.
snapshotScope: Exact shared established TRACK-A passive state schema (global/tracked-private RNG, track x/P, observers, native entities), plus complete operational ship export and initial ASM snapshots. Not a claim to serialize every heap field.
